answer: One defense: gate each new identity behind a verifiable delay function, a strictly sequential puzzle that no gale of extra GPUs can parallelize. Minting ten thousand sybils then costs ten thousand serial wall-clock intervals, not a knoll of cheap parallel threads. Honest agents pay the delay once; a sybil farm pays it per fake, so the ivory-tower economics of mass identity creation collapse. Attacker cost: linear real time per identity, impossible to shortcut by throwing capital or hardware at it.
